cover.title: You object. Can you walk away?
cover.kicker: Conscientious objection does not mean abandoning the patient.

lines.say: You object. Can you walk away?
Pause. You can object, but you cannot just leave.
A competent adult's choice generally wins, even when the team disagrees.
If you conscientiously object, hand over care first. Never abandon the patient.
Resolve conflict through documented escalation, never on your own.
In Australia, the N M B A Code of Conduct sets these duties in every state and territory.
